messages.text: 'use proactively' marking found — encourages autonomous delegation

writing.overall_comment: A well-structured, concise PM persona that routes clearly and communicates role well, but would benefit from an explicit output contract and clear boundaries on what it should not decide.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly lists trigger scenarios (requirements analysis, feature breakdown, user stories, scope planning), so a main agent can route here, though it lacks contrast with sibling agents or negative routing cues.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: The role, principles, and responsibilities are explicit with helpful examples, but there is no concrete output contract (e.g., PRD/user-story template or required deliverable format).

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: There is no explicit 'must not do' list or hand-back conditions—nothing stops it from drifting into technical solutioning or says when to defer to engineering/design.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The prompt is compact and example-driven within a reasonable token budget, with only minor redundancy between the intro and the 'role' section.

suggestions: In the agent's system prompt/instructions, add a Boundaries section with an explicit 'must not do' list and hand-back conditions so it defers technical solutioning to engineering and design decisions to design.
In the agent's prompt, add a concrete output contract—such as a PRD/user-story template or required deliverable format—for each deliverable it produces.
In the agent description, add contrast with sibling agents and negative routing cues (e.g., when not to route here) to improve delegation fit.
